sections.t: Lower A done: a 62-minute strength session in the morning, right on plan. The afternoon walk counts as recovery.

Week 1, Upper A: lat pulldown, barbell bent-over row, seated DB shoulder press, lateral raise, biceps curl, lying leg raise, plank, plus a 3 km easy run. Keep the run at 8:30 to 9:00/km or slower, and take walk breaks if you can't speak in full sentences.
Lifting and running today, so have carbs before and protein after. A Skyr berry bowl works beforehand and a Tuna rice bowl afterwards, keeping the day near 1,750 kcal and 130 g protein.
No run logged since 29 October, and your last three runs were 7:16 to 7:38/km, faster than easy for you. Hold back today and on Sunday's 3.3 km long run.
